other_conditions: Applicant must be selected by the Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India for the pilgrimage
Applicant must have completed the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra
Applicant must not be an income taxpayer
Each individual is eligible for the grant only once in their lifetime
If both husband and wife are selected, eligibility follows the guidelines of the Ministry of External Affairs
Application must be submitted within 60 days of completing the pilgrimage
benefits_summary: State reimburses 50% of pilgrimage expenses up to ₹30,000 per pilgrim.
documents_required: Certificate of actual expenses incurred on the journey
Records of pilgrimage certified by the Ministry of External Affairs
